description: Wires the typed model router into the intake/diagnose/repair path using mocked model outputs only. Adds MockModelClient (task-class-typed canned responses, refuses unauthorized routes), MockedIntakeRepairLoop (composes BuildAdapterRegistry + ModelRouter + MockModelClient over a fixture workspace), and MockedIntakeRepairTrace (immutable per-run trace). Pipeline: BUILD_DIAGNOSIS → PATCH_PLANNING → PATCH_GENERATION → VERIFIER_SUMMARY. Adds a TypeScript broken fixture (tests/fixtures/intake/ts_broken/) and an unsupported_repo fixture. The loop never invokes a real model, never calls the network, never invokes a subprocess, never mutates the fixture tree (sha256 before==after invariant enforced), and never opens corpus or training eligibility.
purpose: Rung 2 of the verified-repair campaign. Proves the apparatus *shape* end-to-end without trusting a live model. The next rungs (SAFE_PATCH_DIFF_ROLLBACK, VERIFIED_REPAIR_TRACE) will replace the canned patch with a temp-workspace application and a fully signed trace; this rung pins the seams.
invariants: MockedIntakeRepairLoop.run(ws) returns an immutable MockedIntakeRepairTrace; never raises on supported fixtures.

For each of the four supported broken fixtures, the trace records diagnose_mock_route_selected=True, patch_plan_mock_generated=True, patch_not_applied_to_source=True, verifier_result_captured=True, training_eligible=False, terminus=MOCK_LOOP_COMPLETE.
The unsupported_repo fixture produces terminus=UNSUPPORTED_REPO with no mock invocations.
Workspace tree sha256 before run == sha256 after run for every fixture (no source mutation).
MockModelClient.invoke raises KeyError on unregistered task class.
scripts/intake/mocked_intake_repair.py contains no `import subprocess`, no `import urllib`, no `import socket`, no `import http`.
scripts/models/mock_client.py contains no `import subprocess`, no `import urllib`.

The loop never imports any module that performs an outbound network call; it never invokes the BuildAdapter._run path on the fixture during this rung (toolchain execution is deferred to SAFE_PATCH_DIFF_ROLLBACK and VERIFIED_REPAIR_TRACE).
Audit counts: BLOCKED_UNSAFE=0, MUST_MIGRATE=0, UNKNOWN=0, PROGRAMBENCH>=56.
Signed evidence is unmutated by loop exercise.
remaining_gaps: The loop does not yet exercise the real BuildAdapter._run path against the fixture. The verifier coverage matrix is consulted only via the router's VERIFIER_SUMMARY task class; an actual `cargo check` (or equivalent) on the fixture is deferred to SAFE_PATCH_DIFF_ROLLBACK_LOCK_001, where the patch is applied to a temp copy first.
MockModelClient is intentionally not a drop-in replacement for a live provider; later rungs will introduce a LiveModelClient under LOCAL_MODEL_ADMISSION_POLICY_LOCK_001.
The fixture for an unsupported repo is minimal (notes.txt). Future rungs may add an ambiguous-multi-language fixture once the registry's multi-match tie-breaker is exercised in coverage.
